Eight months ago, open-weight AI models handled 7% of tokens flowing through Vercel's AI Gateway. Today that number is 56%.

The Financial Times reports that AT&T now runs 40% of its AI workloads on open-weight models, cutting inference costs by 56% through smarter routing. Coinbase reports approximately 50% savings from the same approach.

This matters for every executive making AI investment decisions right now. The shift is not about replacing frontier models — it is about routing intelligently. Complex reasoning tasks still go to frontier models. But high-volume, repeatable tasks that do not require frontier-level capability are being handled by open-weight models at a fraction of the cost.

The result is that organizations with smart routing architectures are covering significantly more operational ground with the same AI budget. They are deploying AI across use cases that were previously uneconomical — not by spending more, but by spending precisely.

For CEOs: your competitor may not have a bigger AI budget. They may just be routing better. For CTOs: the architecture decision is now a portfolio question, and the margin lives in the routing logic.
